parameters.query: WITH input AS ( SELECT $1::int AS in_request_id, UPPER(TRIM($2)) AS in_asset_id ), req AS (SELECT r.* FROM asset_requests r, input i WHERE r.request_id = i.in_request_id AND r.status = 'approved'), a AS (SELECT ast.* FROM assets ast, input i WHERE ast.asset_id = i.in_asset_id) SELECT req.request_id, req.employee_id, req.device_type_id, req.requested_qty, a.asset_id, a.qty AS asset_qty, a.device_type_id AS asset_device_type_id, a.asset_status, (SELECT name FROM device_types WHERE device_type_id = req.device_type_id) AS device_type_name, CASE WHEN req.request_id IS NULL THEN 'Request not found, not yet approved, or already fulfilled.' WHEN a.asset_id IS NULL THEN 'Asset "' || i.in_asset_id || '" does not exist.' WHEN a.asset_status <> 'available' THEN 'Asset ' || i.in_asset_id || ' is not available (status: ' || a.asset_status || ').' WHEN a.device_type_id <> req.device_type_id THEN 'Asset ' || i.in_asset_id || ' is not the requested device type (' || (SELECT name FROM device_types WHERE device_type_id = req.device_type_id) || ').' WHEN a.qty < req.requested_qty THEN 'Asset ' || i.in_asset_id || ' only has ' || a.qty || ' unit(s) available (requested ' || req.requested_qty || ').' ELSE NULL END AS rejection_reason FROM input i LEFT JOIN req ON TRUE LEFT JOIN a ON TRUE;

WITH input AS ( SELECT $1::text AS in_asset_id, $2::text AS in_employee_id, $3::int AS in_qty, $4::int AS in_request_id, $5::text AS in_decided_by, $6::text AS in_notes ), req AS ( SELECT approved_by FROM asset_requests, input WHERE request_id = input.in_request_id ), src AS ( SELECT a.* FROM assets a, input i WHERE a.asset_id = i.in_asset_id ), calc AS ( SELECT i.*, s.qty AS src_qty, (s.qty > i.in_qty) AS needs_split, CASE WHEN s.qty > i.in_qty THEN i.in_asset_id || '-S' || (COALESCE((SELECT count(*) FROM assets WHERE split_from_asset_id = i.in_asset_id), 0) + 1) ELSE i.in_asset_id END AS use_asset_id FROM input i, src s WHERE set_config('app.actor', 'n8n:Portal - Fulfill Asset Request', true) IS NOT NULL ), split_insert AS ( INSERT INTO assets (asset_id, device_type_id, brand, model, office_id, asset_status, purchase_date, purchase_cost, vendor_id, invoice_id, warranty_expiry, acquisition_type, qty, current_employee_id, party_type, split_from_asset_id, remarks) SELECT c.use_asset_id, s.device_type_id, s.brand, s.model, s.office_id, 'available', s.purchase_date, s.purchase_cost, s.vendor_id, s.invoice_id, s.warranty_expiry, s.acquisition_type, c.in_qty, s.current_employee_id, s.party_type, s.asset_id, 'Split from ' || s.asset_id || ' on ' || now()::date FROM calc c JOIN src s ON TRUE WHERE c.needs_split RETURNING asset_id ), split_update_src AS ( UPDATE assets SET qty = qty - c.in_qty, updated_at = now() FROM calc c WHERE assets.asset_id = c.in_asset_id AND c.needs_split RETURNING assets.asset_id ), new_alloc AS ( INSERT INTO asset_allocations (asset_id, employee_id, qty_allocated, requested_by, status, source, approved_at, approved_by, allocated_at) SELECT c.use_asset_id, c.in_employee_id, c.in_qty, c.in_employee_id, 'active', 'n8n_fulfillment', now(), req.approved_by, now() FROM calc c, req RETURNING allocation_id, asset_id, employee_id ), updated_asset AS ( UPDATE assets SET current_employee_id = (SELECT employee_id FROM new_alloc), party_type = 'person', asset_status = 'in_use' WHERE asset_id = (SELECT asset_id FROM new_alloc) RETURNING asset_id ), updated_req AS ( UPDATE asset_requests SET status='fulfilled', fulfilled_by=$5, fulfilled_asset_id=(SELECT asset_id FROM new_alloc), fulfillment_notes=NULLIF(TRIM($6),''), fulfilled_at=now(), resulting_allocation_id=(SELECT allocation_id FROM new_alloc) WHERE request_id=$4 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM new_alloc) RETURNING request_id, resulting_allocation_id ) SELECT ur.request_id, ur.resulting_allocation_id AS allocation_id, na.asset_id, na.employee_id FROM updated_req ur JOIN new_alloc na ON TRUE;
SELECT wc.phone_number, $1::bigint AS request_id, $2::text AS asset_id, $3::text AS device_type_name, $4::text AS employee_id FROM whatsapp_contacts wc WHERE wc.employee_id = $4;

parameters.query: UPDATE it_requests SET status='resolved', resolved_at=now() WHERE source_asset_request_id = $1 AND set_config('app.actor', 'n8n:Portal - Fulfill Asset Request', true) IS NOT NULL;
